column1: # Session 11 (travel12), rule TP1: the viewpoint of each DS1 bonfire's Travel picture (Build/Maps/TravelPictures.cs renders
# DS1's own map pieces, lightmaps, LightBank / FogBank and bonfire model from it; `lr travel-render ENTITY OUT.png` shows one,
# `--sweep [DIST] [HEIGHT]` eight candidates around the bonfire). DS1 world coordinates; yaw like the MSB (facing
# (-sin, -cos)); pitch up positive; fov horizontal degrees; exposure x the automatic one. Chosen from 8-view sweeps
# (6 m back, 2.5 m up). The Asylum courtyard and Firelink rows are used only when no in-game screenshot
# Columns (TAB): DS1 map | DS1 bonfire entity | eye x | eye y | eye z | yaw | pitch | fov | exposure | note
